title: A Asset for the Cipher
author: Sebastian Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
